items.html: And behold, it has been explained that all of ZA is only nine Sefirot, even though it is divided into three aspects. And these are complete nine Sefirot, and no more is needed. And indeed, each of these Sefirot is divided into many details, for each Sefira of the external ones is divided into a thousand myriads, each Sefira of the middle ones into six thousand myriads, and each Sefira of the internal one is divided into ten thousand myriads of parsot, as mentioned in Tikkun 53.
